# Carsen

> Local-first MCP knowledge engine that serves cited retrieval over your code and documents.

Carsen indexes code and documents into isolated, on-disk knowledge bases and serves the
passages that answer a query — each with a checkable citation (source path, line span,
commit-pinned link) — over the Model Context Protocol. Nothing leaves the machine unless
configured to, and the generative LLM stays replaceable. It works in a sparse-only mode
with no vector database and no embedding model; dense semantic retrieval is an opt-in extra.

## Setup

- [Set up with an AI agent](https://github.com/LorenzoMugnai/Carsen/blob/main/docs/agent-setup.md): step-by-step install recipe an agent can execute, with checks
- [Quickstart](https://github.com/LorenzoMugnai/Carsen/blob/main/docs/quickstart.md): install through to a served instance
- [Connect to an LLM](https://github.com/LorenzoMugnai/Carsen/blob/main/docs/llm-integration.md): point an MCP client at a running instance
- [Configuration](https://github.com/LorenzoMugnai/Carsen/blob/main/docs/configuration.md): every YAML field
- [CLI reference](https://github.com/LorenzoMugnai/Carsen/blob/main/docs/cli-reference.md)
